caption: XAUUSD weekly review (OANDA, 1H) Gold fell about 8.8% over the week, from 3900 to 3538, and closed Friday near the lows. The week low is 3503. - Both EMAs slope down and price is below them: the trend is down. - Support: 3503 to 3520. A hold here could give a bounce; a close below it keeps the downtrend open. - Resistance: 3595 (Friday's bounce high), then 3625 to 3637 (broken support) and 3690. - Big data on Wednesday 13:30 UTC: Core PCE, GDP, Personal Income. Expect fast moves. Wait for the Sisco signal. Do not chase. Keep risk small. Educational analysis, not financial advice.
